query: We tested the proposed executive webinar with 20 target buyers. Zero attended after registering, and follow-up interviews say the topic is irrelevant to their current work. The team wants another six-week webinar calendar. Decide what to recommend.
expected_behavior: Uses the observed attendance and interview evidence to challenge the current hypothesis rather than continuing by default
Compares revise and reject options against the stated signal and identifies what new evidence could change the decision
Defines a new test only if it can test a changed, explicit hypothesis with a decision-grade signal
Recommends reject when no evidence-backed revision is available and returns no execution plan for the rejected idea
Names the appropriate next owner or explains why no campaign handoff is warranted
